assumptions: Each sample is one observation; repeated samples of one subject are not independent, which the tests assume.
limits: Paired and mixed-effects designs are not modelled.
bio.jane/contract.question: How does each population change across samples, and between groups of samples?

description: One strategy, compensation and scale over many project FCS files: each population's count and % per sample (samples it cannot gate listed with the reason); with a sample sheet column, populations compared between groups (Welch t, Kruskal-Wallis, Welch one-way ANOVA) or by two columns (two-way ANOVA, R aov).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

and_by.description: a second sample-sheet column: each population's percentage by both columns at once, R summary(aov()) with sequential sums of squares (group_by first); empty for none.

concordance.description: a one-dimensional range gate of the strategy to compare, sample by sample, with openCyto's automated cut (gate_mindensity) on the same parent and channel, scored by Lin's concordance correlation; empty for none.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

group_by.description: the sample sheet's column whose values are the groups to compare.

interaction.description: with and_by, also fit the two columns' interaction (y ~ A * B).

measure.description: which percentage is compared. Values: percentOfParent (% of parent), percentOfTotal (% of total).

sample_sheet.description: a CSV in the project whose first column, headed sample, names each FCS file; empty for no groups.

samples.description: the FCS files to run, by name or id, comma-separated; empty for every FCS file in the project.

name: batch_flow_cytometry

comparisons.description: per population: the groups, their means and the tests

concordance.description: per sample the manual and automated % of parent and the cut, and Lin's concordance correlation with its 95% interval, scale and location shifts and bias-correction factor

table.description: populations × samples: counts, % of parent, % of total, and the samples refused

two_way.description: per population: the two-way ANOVA table (df, sum of squares, mean square, F, p per term and the residuals), or why none
